settings.announcementHint: Shown at the top of the public site. Leave empty to hide.
settings.maintenanceHint: Visitors see a maintenance page; admins are not affected.
settings.socialsHint: Shown as icons in the site footer.
settings.titleTemplateHint: %s is replaced with the page title, e.g. %s · Site name
settings.robotsTxtHint: Leave empty for the default template; overridden while “Block indexing” is on.
settings.noindexHint: For staging; emits a noindex meta tag and disallows the whole site in robots.txt.

appearance.subtitle: Customize the site theme colors, corner radius, hero style and default mode.
appearance.defaultThemeHint: First-time visitors see this mode; a visitor's own toggle still wins.
appearance.previewHint: Applies site-wide after saving. Preview is a miniature mock.

data.exportHint: Download all categories, cards and tags as a file you can keep off-server.
data.importUrlTitle: Import from a URL / cloud-drive link
data.importUrlHint: Paste a direct-download link to a JSON/CSV export. Works with any cloud drive that can produce a direct link.
data.cloudTips: Works with any direct-download link, e.g.:
data.confirmRestore: Restoring replaces the current content. A safety snapshot is created first.

ads.codeHint: Paste the full ad tag exactly as provided by the network (JS/HTML/iframe kept as-is)
ads.codeHintImage: Image ads: paste a complete ＜img＞ snippet, or just an image URL
ads.emptyBody: Create your first ad to start serving.
ads.providerExists: A verification for this provider already exists

ads.adsTxtHint: ads.txt content is stored in DB and served live at /ads.txt. Syntax: domain, pub-id, DIRECT|RESELLER, cert-id. Lines starting with # are comments.

adver.subtitle: Ownership verification for ad networks: meta tags go into ＜head＞ automatically, verification files are served by a dynamic route, DNS entries are recorded for reference only.
adver.sectionMeta: Method 1: Meta tag (auto-injected into the site ＜head＞)
adver.metaHint: Example: name = google-site-verification, content = the token from the platform. Tags of all networks are merged into ＜head＞.
adver.sectionFile: Method 2: File verification (served dynamically — no file on disk)
adver.fileNameHint: E.g. google1234abcd.html — after saving, https://your-domain/＜file name＞ returns its content directly.
adver.dnsHint: DNS cannot be managed by this app. Add the record at your registrar, then log it here for reference.
adver.activeHint: Disabling takes the meta tags and file responses offline immediately.
adver.emptyBody: Add a configuration when an ad network requires site ownership verification.

waf.title: Kun 1.0 · Security Center
waf.sampleNote: Only a truncated sample is stored; the full request is never persisted.
waf.modeHint: off = disabled, log = observe only, block = enforce. Switching to block is dangerous.
waf.hotReloadHint: Takes effect within 10s after save — no restart needed.
waf.kunBansHint: Live snapshot from the engine. Tick and release — applied on next config push (≤10s).
waf.lockedBody: The security engine has locked the admin area. It will unlock automatically when the timer ends.
